scope: Clio activities (time, timers, expenses, categories, UTBMS, rates and precedence), billing (generation, themes, batch/split, discounts, interest, LEDES, approval, collections, payment plans, settings, Canadian taxes)

features.name: Time entries (manual)
features.where: Activities > New time entry; global Create new; matter dashboard
features.what: Time entry with user, matter, date, duration, activity category, description, rate; save, save and create another, save and duplicate.

features.name: Timer
features.where: Header timer; timer icon on a time entry
features.what: Start/pause timer tied to an activity; API exposes start_time and elapsed hours. Whether several timers can be paused at once could not be confirmed from sources.

features.name: Non-billable entries shown on bill
features.where: Time entry modal: Non-billable + Show the entry on the bill
features.what: Mark time non-billable and optionally still print it on the bill.

features.name: Time entries from communications/calendar
features.what: Creating time from a logged communication carries its subject into the description.

features.name: Text snippets
features.what: Abbreviation that expands to a longer phrase in descriptions; optional trailing-space trigger. Seen only via API connector docs.

features.name: Mobile time and expense entry
features.what: Create, duplicate (swipe) time and expense entries on mobile.

features.name: Activity categories
features.what: Firm-wide labels for time/expense with billing method: user default rate, custom rate, or flat rate; no-charge = flat 0.00.

features.name: Rate hierarchy
features.what: Precedence: custom on entry > flat fee > matter rate > client rate > activity-category custom rate > user default. Changing matter or category on an entry drops a typed custom rate.

features.name: Client (contact) rates per user or group
features.what: Contact-level rates for individual users or groups; multiple client rates per matter.

features.name: Billing rate report
features.what: Shows effective user rate per matter: matter rate > client rate > default.

features.name: Flat fee matters
features.what: Auto-creates the flat fee entry; time tracked at 0.00/hr.

features.name: Expense entries
features.where: Activities > New expense; matter Activities subtab
features.what: Expense with amount, date, category, receipt attachment; soft costs to 4 decimals.

features.name: Hard / soft cost tracking
features.where: Settings > Billing > Expenses (US); General (UK: disbursements vs expense recoveries)
features.what: Optional toggle to classify expenses as hard (paid to third party) or soft (internal); hard costs sync to Clio Accounting Funds out.
features.plan_tier: all plans; Clio Accounting for sync

features.name: Receipt autofill
features.where: Expense entry > upload receipt (pilot) / Manage AI
features.what: AI reads uploaded receipt and fills amount, date, reference, description; only fills empty fields.

features.name: UTBMS codes
features.what: Enable standard code sets (task, activity, expense) on time and expense entries; cannot be required; no custom codes.

features.name: Manage AI time entry suggestions
features.product: Clio Manage (Manage AI, formerly Clio Duo)
features.where: Matter dashboard AI Actions card; AI Launchpad
features.what: Proactively suggests time entries for unlogged calls, notes, emails, completed tasks; user accepts.

features.name: Clio Timekeeping (passive capture)
features.what: Background capture of email/document time in 1-minute increments for review and logging; desktop app suggests entries for work outside Clio; user chooses capture hours. Pilot.

features.name: Personal billable target
features.where: Settings > Profile > Personal Performance; Dashboard > Personal Dashboard
features.what: User sets default rate, annual target billings, working days, fiscal year end; dashboard compares target with logged billable time.

features.name: Productivity report
features.what: CSV tracing time from recorded to discounted/written-off, billed, collected, outstanding (realization).

features.name: AI metrics Q&A
features.what: Ask billed/unbilled hours and utilization in chat.

features.name: Bill generation: quick bill and bulk billing
features.where: Billing > Create bills; matter > Quick bill
features.what: Generate one or many bills across matters/clients, or a combined bill per client; aggregation options (by type, services only, expenses only); excluded activities stay unbilled.

features.name: Manage AI automated billing
features.where: Gem icon > Automate your bills; Billing > Automated Billing
features.what: Scheduled AI-generated draft bills with frequency, minimum amount, include flat/contingency matters, cut-off rule; drafts land in Pending approval, flagged duplicates/unusual entries, auto routing and internal reminders.

features.name: Bill states and approval
features.where: Billing > quick filters; Edit > Submit for approval / Approve bill
features.what: Draft > pending approval (assigned firm user) > unpaid/awaiting payment > paid; void. Approval can be skipped. Clio does not record who approved or when.

features.name: Edit bills, edit approved bills setting
features.where: Bill > Edit; Settings > Billing > General > Bill States
features.what: Full edit in draft/pending; approved bills limited unless setting enabled; 'Update records' pushes edits back to activities; paid bills need payment deleted first.

features.name: Discounts
features.what: Whole-bill (percent or amount, spread proportionally) or per-line discounts with note; applied before tax, after credit notes; early-payment discount via payment profile auto-expires.

features.name: Interest via payment profiles
features.where: Settings > Billing > Payment profiles; assign to contact
features.what: Profile sets grace period, rate, interval; interest accrues from day after grace, on whole unpaid bill, as line items, until paid/void; only applied at bill generation.

features.name: Taxes (primary/secondary, up to 15 rates)
features.what: Up to 15 named tax rates (4 decimals) usable on expenses and bills; primary + secondary tax, each optionally default on all bills; trust requests carry no tax. No built-in Canadian province logic found.

features.name: Bill themes
features.what: Unlimited themes: page setup, localization, watermark, header, invoice info, columns, fonts, logo, payment link; live preview; admin/billing permission.

features.name: Billing templates (drag-and-drop)
features.what: Single-canvas visual bill designer; early access.

features.name: Split billing
features.where: Matter > Edit > Billing preference > Split invoice
features.what: Payers with percentage portions totaling 100%; hourly/flat only; split columns on theme; 'Split invoice' pill.

features.name: LEDES export
features.where: Bill > download LEDES; Settings for firm ID; contact LEDES client ID
features.what: Individual or bulk LEDES 1998B and 1998BI; firm ID/tax ID, client ID, timekeeper classification; requires UTBMS; download does not mark sent.

features.name: Multi-currency
features.what: Add currencies; matter billing currency; expense conversion at expense date, bill date or manual rate; default currency locked once others added; not compatible with Clio Accounting.

features.name: Bill filters and exports
features.what: Filter bills by client, matter, originating/responsible attorney, sent date, due/issue date, overdue, type, currency, custom fields.

features.name: Bill reminders (manual and automated)
features.where: Billing > Outstanding Balances > Send / Reminders toggle
features.what: One-off or scheduled reminders for unpaid approved bills, keyed from issue date; email with secure PDF link, optional SMS with pay link; logged to Communications.

features.name: Clio Payments
features.what: Card + Apple/Google Pay; Canada: Visa, MC, Amex, debit (some restricted); eCheck/ACH US only; payouts in local currency in ~2 business days; one stored method per client in Canada.

features.name: Payment plans
features.what: Recurring card payments to balance, trust, or ongoing services; weekly/bi-weekly/monthly; pays oldest due bill first (fixed); Canada card only.

features.name: Autocharge
features.what: Named schedules charging stored method on approval, on due date, or N days after issue; applied per client; phased rollout.

features.name: Surcharging in Canada
features.what: Credit only, cap 2.4% and cost of acceptance, not debit/wallet/trust, not Quebec firms or Quebec cardholders, needs surcharge-free option, line item shown.

features.name: Collections integrations
features.what: Third-party collections automation (e.g. Kolleno); no native collections case management found.

gaps.proposal: Add format enum value 'LEDES 1998BI' with currency, tax rate and firm/client address fields; timekeeper classification code on users (PT/AS/PL/LA/OT) and LEDES client ID on contacts; validation refuses export when UTBMS codes missing; export does not set 'sent'.
Payment profile gains 'early payment discount %' and 'valid days'; bill shows discounted amount due until expiry; agent removes the discount line on expiry and logs it; discount is pre-HST.

gaps.feature: Discount ordering rule (after credit notes, before tax; spread proportionally)
gaps.proposal: State rule on invoice-editor: whole-bill discount spread proportionally across lines for HST and realization reporting; applied after credit notes, before HST; when interest exists, payments/discount hit principal before interest (Ontario s.33 check).

TaxProfile supports GST 5% + provincial PST/QST as separate lines for out-of-province clients (QC 9.975% QST, BC/MB/SK PST rules for legal services), not only HST; agent proposes place-of-supply with rationale; up to 4-decimal rates.

gaps.feature: Automated scheduled bill drafts (Manage AI automated billing)
gaps.proposal: Billing cycle drafts job already exists; add explicit settings: frequency, cut-off rule (entries created before X vs dated before X), minimum bill amount, include flat/contingency toggle, and an 'anomalies' panel (duplicates, unusual entries) on pre-bill-review.
Keep: our G-B2 logs approver and time; Clio's help says it does not show who approved. Surface 'approved by / at' on the bill and in versus page.
When a line is edited on a draft, ask whether to change the source TimeEntry (default yes before approval); record as WriteDown when amount drops.

gaps.feature: Aggregation options on bill (by type, services only, expenses only)
gaps.proposal: Add 'Line grouping' enum on bill-themes: itemized | aggregate fees and disbursements | aggregate fees only | aggregate disbursements only | by timekeeper | by UTBMS phase.

gaps.feature: Bill reminders by SMS with pay link
gaps.proposal: Add channel enum email | SMS to collections-reminders; SMS contains amount and pay link only, no matter detail; consent recorded per contact.
Keep delivery-date anchor (Ontario Solicitors Act timing); Clio anchors on issue date. Document in versus page.
Autopay option gets trigger enum: on approval | on due date | N days after delivery; never before delivery of the account; gated by G-B9 per client.
State allocation: oldest due bill first, then oldest created; firm may override per plan (Clio fixes it).
Add firm and personal snippets (abbreviation -> phrase) usable in narrative fields; agent narrative style guide may reference them.
Live preview on bill-themes with sample bill (Clio themes have live preview); drag-and-drop not needed in v1.
Add 'working days per year' and 'fiscal year end' to TimekeeperTarget so capacity math matches Clio's personal target.

gaps.feature: Hard/soft cost toggle and accounting sync
gaps.proposal: Our 'agency' field maps to hard (agent) vs soft (firm cost); add report column naming them 'disbursement' vs 'firm cost recovery' for Ontario usage.
Rates screen: allow client-level rate overrides keyed by user OR role group, and more than one client rate per matter; show resolved rate source chain on entry.
Keep Rebuild day; note Clio now has native suggestions (Manage AI) and pilot Clio Timekeeping, so our edge is accuracy, sources cited per suggestion, and Canada-resident processing, not existence.
Remove '(verify)' on Quebec and 2.4% cap; also exclude debit, prepaid, wallets; require surcharge-free option; Law Society position check per province.

corrections.our_claim: versus-clio: Clio time capture is 'Timers' (vs our agent rebuilding the day)
corrections.truth: Clio Manage AI suggests time entries from unlogged calls, notes, emails and completed tasks, and Clio Timekeeping (pilot) passively captures email/document and desktop time for review. Claim should say Clio has AI suggestions; our difference is breadth, citations and gating.

corrections.our_claim: versus-clio: Clio 'People work; AI assists on request'
corrections.truth: Manage AI has proactive actions (suggested time entries, scheduled automated bill drafts routed for approval). Reword to 'AI proposes some items; no single approval queue or citations'.
Unproven for Clio users: Manage AI automated billing generates drafts on a schedule, flags duplicates, routes approvals. Present as an estimate for manual firms, not a Clio fact.

corrections.our_claim: time.json clio_gaps: 'AI time entry suggestions (Clio Duo / third-party)', where 'integrations, AI features 2025'
corrections.truth: Native in Clio Manage as Manage AI (renamed from Clio Duo) plus Clio Timekeeping pilot; not only third-party.

corrections.our_claim: billing.json clio_gaps: LEDES 'Settings > Billing > General > LEDES'
corrections.truth: Clio exports both LEDES 1998B and 1998BI per bill or in bulk; requires UTBMS enabled under Settings > Billing > UTBMS Codes; firm ID in settings, client ID on contact. Exact menu for LEDES is not 'General > LEDES' in sources found.

corrections.our_claim: billing.json clio_gaps: 'Trust applied to bills automatically on approval' and 'Payment allocation order settings (proportional by default)'
corrections.truth: Not confirmed by any source found in this pass; mark unverified until checked. Confirmed automatic charging is Autocharge of stored card methods, not trust.

corrections.our_claim: billing.json payment-settings: card surcharge 'not in Quebec (verify)'; reg '2.4% (verify)'
corrections.truth: Confirmed by Clio's Canada surcharging article: 2.4% cap and cost of acceptance, credit only, excludes Quebec firms and Quebec cardholders, excludes trust payments.

corrections.our_claim: billing.json clio_gaps: Interest 'grace period, rate' only
corrections.truth: Clio profiles also set an accrual interval; interest is a bill line item from day after grace, whole unpaid bill, until paid/void, and only attaches at generation (existing bills must be regenerated).

open_questions: Does Clio allow several timers paused at once? Not confirmed (help.clio.com 403, Wayback blocked).
Clio rounding options (increment, up/nearest) and whether changes re-round billed entries: unconfirmed this pass; spec's claim cites 14078692470427 but snippet not seen.
Does Clio offer timesheet approval or entry locking? Nothing found; likely absent, verify.
Is Clio interest simple or compound? Sources do not say.
Exact plan tiers for Manage AI, split billing, UTBMS/LEDES: sources conflict (Essentials/Advanced/Expand vs Core/Signature/Elite naming vs add-on).
Does Clio auto-apply trust to bills on approval and default to proportional payment allocation? Unverified.
Clio Payments Canada: PAD/Interac not found; confirm absence before claiming as our edge.
method_note: help.clio.com and clio.com returned 403 to direct fetch; web.archive.org blocked for this agent. All Clio facts come from official help-center search snippets (confidence medium) unless marked low. No page was opened in full, so no feature is high confidence.
